description: Captain Marcus Chaplin and XO Sam Kendal refuse an irregular order to launch nuclear missiles at Pakistan, survive an attack by their own navy, and seize the NATO station on Sainte Marina to keep the USS Colorado and its crew alive. Chaplin's nuclear deterrent buys time but turns the island into a pressure cooker: Prosser challenges his command, local strongman Julian Serrat exploits the crisis, China moves in, and Washington pressures the sailors' families while Kylie Sinclair and Christine Kendal uncover evidence of the conspiracy. The standoff ends in mutiny, a battle for the submarine and Chaplin's final decision to keep the Colorado from becoming someone else's weapon.

s01e01.description: Five hundred feet beneath the ocean's surface, the crew of the Ohio-class ballistic missile submarine "USS Colorado" - the most powerful nuclear submarine ever built -- receive their orders. Over a communications channel designed only to be used if the U.S. homeland has been wiped out, they're told to fire nuclear weapons at a foreign country. Captain Marcus Chaplin demands confirmation of the orders, only to be unceremoniously relieved of duty. XO Sam Kendal finds himself suddenly in charge of the submarine and facing the same difficult decision. When he also demands confirmation of the orders, the Colorado is fired upon and hit. The submarine and its crew, honorable patriots, now find themselves crippled on the ocean floor and declared rogue enemies of their own country.

s01e02.description: More than 20 warships are closing on the 200-mile perimeter that Marcus Chaplin declared as a no man's land around the island. And as XO Sam Kendal is drawn into a battle on the ground to keep them alive, Prosser confronts Marcus about something personal to him that could be impacting his judgment as Captain of the Colorado.

s01e03.description: Prosser is released from the brig to help locate three missing Colorado sailors, only for Chaplin to learn that Serrat has kidnapped them. Serrat demands that the submarine retrieve cargo from outside the naval perimeter; the Colorado completes the mission but returns late, and Serrat kills one hostage. In Washington, Kylie and Admiral Shepard trace the original launch order while the Perseus stealth-system plans disappear from Kylie's apartment.

s01e04.description: With morale collapsing and treason charges announced against him and Sam, Chaplin lets the crew choose whether to remain with the Colorado. The Defense Department secretly sends individual sailors orders authorizing action against their captain, culminating in Brennan threatening the bridge with a grenade and attempting to force the submarine toward surrender. In the United States, Christine faces official pressure and public harassment while Sam's old friend Paul Wells offers support.

s01e05.description: In an attempt to end the standoff on Sainte Marina, Marcus and Sam enter into tense negotiations with the U.S. Government. Meanwhile, when a critical system fails, Grace must take command of the Colorado on a perilous repair operation.

s01e06.description: The crew is hit with an attack by an unknown force unlike anything they've seen before. As confusion and aggression take hold, Marcus and Sam can no longer trust their own senses even as they race to save the sub and defend the island.

s01e07.description: Chaplin investigates the BZ attack and the theft of one of his nuclear launch keys, increasing suspicion throughout the crew. Prosser's confrontation with Serrat escalates over Serrat's role in the attack and the drug trade among the sailors, while a surviving SEAL tells Sam that a faction in Washington wants Chaplin removed in exchange for amnesty. Christine and Kylie continue building a public case against the government's version of events.

s01e08.description: A Thanksgiving feast meant to ease tensions between the Colorado crew and Sainte Marina collapses when islander Erita accuses Chief Anders of rape. Grace Shepard defends Anders at a joint island-Navy trial, then realizes Serrat manipulated the jury to provoke unrest; Anders ultimately admits the assault, and Chaplin discharges him and orders him held for prosecution.

s01e09.description: A transport carrying forty relatives of the Colorado crew, including Christine Kendal, is seized by Pakistani commandos who demand that Chaplin fire a nuclear missile at Indian forces entering Pakistan. At the same time, the original SEAL mission is exposed: Hopper had been ordered by the Secretary of Defense to plant false evidence of Pakistani suitcase nuclear weapons, tying the fabricated intelligence directly to the crisis that triggered the Colorado's launch order.

s01e10.description: Sam and James depart the island in a daring rescue attempt. Back on the island of Sainte Marina, a Chinese diplomat arrives to make a deal with Marcus. With scarcity and a prison problem plaguing him, Marcus finds himself treading down a more treacherous path than he could have imagined.

s01e11.description: A U.S. Navy destroyer moves to intercept the Chinese supply ship headed for Sainte Marina, forcing Chaplin to defend the aid route and risk a direct confrontation. In Washington, Kylie takes evidence of the President's Pakistan deception to the Speaker as Admiral Shepard helps organize a coup, while Cortez admits she has been secretly paid by the CIA and refuses an order to kill Chaplin. Serrat separately bargains with China over the island's rare-earth deposits.

s01e12.description: Kylie works with Admiral Shepard to bring down the President, using evidence of what really happened in Pakistan. This affords Marcus the opportunity to surrender the Colorado, if all goes according to plan.

s01e13.description: Prosser's mutiny is hijacked by men planning to hand the Colorado to China, leaving Chaplin, Sam, Grace and Prosser fighting to regain control of the submarine. Chaplin retakes the conn and ultimately destroys the Colorado rather than allow it to become another government's weapon, sacrificing himself in the process. In Washington, Kylie releases evidence of the President's conspiracy after arranging Christine's return and then shoots the President.
